confidence_notes: Medium for beer, coffee and meal anchors, which rest on several 2025-2026 aggregated guides that disagree with each other. Low for the hostel and hotel anchors, which come from booking-site listings and one unverified report, with a July high-season uplift applied by judgement. Cocktail is set from the UK average and the beer relationship because London-specific evidence was weak. The FX observation came from a search summary dated 2026-03-20, not a verified read of the live RBA F11 table, so it is about seven months older than the 2026-10-16 generation date. Pound-sterling figures were converted to USD at an assumed rate, not a sourced one.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. London was priced directly from London and UK-wide sources: pub pint and restaurant guides, cappuccino guides, and hostel and hotel booking-site listings.
